issues.description: Inbound table repeats Device Knob1–8 at CC0x18–0x1F and Track Knob1–8 at CC0x38–0x3F, which outbound chart identifies as ring-style addresses. Do not recast as physical input. Note0x41 is both Detail View and stray Metronome(8); unlabeled CLIP STOP row retained raw.
excluded_bindings: Input CC24–31, CC56–63; Note65 Detail View/Metronome ambiguity

issues.description: Cue Level CC0x2F appears in absolute and relative inbound tables. Relative table defines signed delta but no authoritative correction distinguishes Cue. Excluded pending clarification.
Generic-mode note banking/toggles are not normalized beyond definite CC banks. Introduction/inquiry and ring segment bit patterns remain complete raw evidence; dedicated adapter required.
excluded_bindings: Generic-mode note behavior; SysEx initialization/inquiry; detailed ring segment lookup
